notes.title: Infinite Darkness HD Upgrade LIVE!
notes.content:
The latest Nyctophobia HD update is now available for both PC and Mac. See below for a list of changes/improvements.

[h1]Nyctophobia: Infinite Darkness Update Release Notes[/h1]

Graphics Updates:
[list]
[*]HD terrain with new textures
[*]New tent
[*]New flashlight
[*]New campfire
[*]New trees
[*]New covered bridge
[*]New skeleton
[*]New railroad tracks
[*]New area: Lakeview Railyard & Depot
[*]New landmines
[*]New military jeep
[*]New crates
[*]New perimeter fence
[*]Upgraded fence textures
[*]New rocks
[*]New flame effects
[*]New volumetric light effects in “Own the Night” mode
[*]Texture improvements in “Own the Night” mode 
[*]Cutscene graphics improved
[*]Mac graphics improved 
[*]Water textures improved 
[/list]
Gameplay Fixes:
[list]
[*]Sound regions bug fix
[*]Invert mouse option fixed
[*]Own the Night sound effects improved
[*]Over 30 new HD footstep sounds added
[*]Camera effects improved
[*]Battery indicator bug fixed
[*]Battery lasts longer 
[/list]

Enjoy this upgrade free of charge. 
[h1]Fight the fright. Find the light. [/h1]

notes.title: October Update - PATCH 10/11
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed 
[list]
[*]Draw distance lowered for spookier atmosphere
[*]Barricades fixed and models improved
[*]Difficulty adjusted 
[*]Character proportions fixed
[*]Train station teleportation bug fixed
[*]Intro sequence improved
[*]Flame effects and Keeper chase improved
[*]Tree collision issues fixed
[*]Mouse invert option added
[*]Mac support issues fixed
[*]Misc. fixes
[/list]

Again, I would like to thank the steam community for their continued support and helpful suggestions that made these updates possible.

notes.title: Minor Update Added - PATCH 8/28
notes.content:
Fixed:
-Instances where it was possible to fall off of the map
-Truck lighting effects improved
-First note revised for greater difficulty 
-Explanatory text doesn't disappear as quickly
-Minefield slightly more challenging

I would like to thank everyone in the steam community who helped clarify these problems and made these updates possible.
